official_definition: When your "Sky"-named Spirit/Ultimate is summoned, you can send the 20px from your Reserve to your Life. This effect can only be used once per turn.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Sky Seal] or [Sky Seal: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Sky Seal]", "give [Sky Seal]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
